name: Image-Space Partitioning (Tile Size Optimization)
aliases: Image Tile Sizing and Work Assignment Strategy
definition: A tunable parameter optimization for shared-memory raycasting where the image is divided into tiles distributed among threads. The size and shape of these tiles affect performance due to mutex contention (small tiles) and load imbalance (large tiles).
summary: Image-Space Partitioning divides images into tiles to balance mutex contention and load imbalance, distinguishing itself by empirically tuning tile dimensions for specific hardware rather than using fixed constants.
